breaking_changes: Version format changed from X.Y.Z (e.g. 11.9.0) to YYYY.WW.N (e.g. 2026.39.0); any scripts, config, or automation that parse the version string must be updated to the new format.

GET /pull/variants now returns HTTP 400 for GGUF repositories that lack supported architecture metadata instead of accepting them; callers expecting the endpoint to succeed for any GGUF filename will receive an error.

ModelInfo.registry_source in GET /models and GET /pull/variants responses now defaults to empty string instead of 'huggingface'; any client that assumes the source field is always 'huggingface' or 'modelscope' will see '' and may misinterpret it.

Backend SSE streams returning HTTP 200 without any data events are now reported as 502 errors instead of being silently treated as successful empty completions; clients that previously accepted empty-but-successful completions will now see error events.
The undocumented /internal/mcp/* admin endpoints introduced in a prior release have been reverted; users who began using them will see 404s.
The unstable Linux Distro Builds CI job (Arch + openSUSE containers) has been removed; its status is no longer a merge gate.

evidence.blockers: The candidate release publishing workflow and prerelease classification on GitHub must be verified before shipping — without this, Windows/Fedora/Debian/macOS users may not be able to find or install release candidates, and candidates could appear as stable releases. The new version format must be confirmed in a built artifact. The FLM ModelScope download path and the empty registry_source API encoding need manual verification before the release ships.
evidence.breaking_changes: The version format shift (X.Y.Z to YYYY.WW.N) is a breaking change to any consumer of the version string — it appears in the server startup log, MSI installer metadata, server manifest, and is consumed by CMake at build time. The /pull/variants endpoint now rejects incompatible GGUF repos with HTTP 400, which callers may have depended on. The registry_source API encoding change from 'huggingface' to empty string for unpinned downloads may break clients. The SSE empty-stream fix changes error reporting behavior silently. The MCP client feature was removed entirely.
evidence.coverage: 41 commit reviews cover the reviewed range; 2 commits have no review and are not in the digest.
evidence.manual_testing: New infrastructure: the weekly release-branch creation workflow, the candidate prerelease publishing pipeline, and the candidate Docker tag have never been exercised end-to-end in production. The new version format must be seen in a real build artifact. The wildcard-origin feature, session-header relay to cloud providers, the /v1/docs API endpoint, the MCP lemonade_docs tool, the FLM ModelScope download path, the soft-idle cache resume for llama.cpp, and the /images/edit endpoint are all user-facing surfaces with no evidence of human exercise before merge.
evidence.security: Wildcard port and subdomain origin matching was reviewed by a security maintainer with strict dot-boundary enforcement. Session-header relay uses a well-known-only allowlist and excludes telemetry headers. The vendored model-viewer bundle has a CI drift guard and documented secure update process. The /v1/docs endpoint guards against path traversal. No new credential handling or supply-chain concerns observed.
